literal: Fullness of character not departing if one desires, possession of forbearance cherishing to practice is fit.
translation: If one desires that fullness of character never departs from them, they must cherish and practice forbearance.
modern: ஒருவர் தன்னிடம் உள்ள நிறைவான நற்பண்புகள் நீங்காமல் இருக்க விரும்பினால், அவர் பொறுமையைப் போற்றிப் பின்பற்ற வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the relationship between self-control or moral completeness (நிறையுடைமை) and forbearance (பொறையுடைமை). The author states that if a person wishes to retain their noble qualities and integrity without losing them, they must actively cherish and practice patience. Here, 'நிறை' refers to the abundance of good virtues and self-discipline, while 'பொறை' represents the capacity to endure wrongs. Thus, forbearance is presented as the essential protective shield that preserves all other virtues from slipping away.
